analysis_completeness.description: Fraction of the evidence catalog that was collected. Null when the command did not score owners.

reviews_sampled.description: Closed pull requests included in the ownership review sample. 0 when that sample was not collected.

reviews_window_days.description: Whole days from the analysis instant back to the oldest included pull. 0 when no pull was included.

limitation.const: historical_activity_confidence and avg_qualified_owner_count use recency and frequency only (historical-v1). They are not ownership_score (ownership-v1).

examples.limitation: historical_activity_confidence and avg_qualified_owner_count use recency and frequency only (historical-v1). They are not ownership_score (ownership-v1).
